# Tasks: Book Embedding Ingestion Pipeline

**Feature**: Book Embedding Ingestion Pipeline
**Branch**: `001-book-embedding-ingestion`
**Date**: 2026-01-01
**Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Plan**: [plan.md](./plan.md)
**Status**: Generated by `/sp.tasks` command

## Implementation Strategy

The implementation will follow a phased approach focusing on the core ingestion pipeline. Each user story will be implemented as a complete, independently testable increment. The MVP scope includes User Story 1 (Documentation Content Ingestion) which provides the foundational capability to crawl and extract clean text content from Docusaurus sites.

## Dependencies

- User Story 2 (Embedding Generation) depends on User Story 1 (Documentation Content Ingestion) for clean text chunks
- User Story 3 (Vector Database Storage) depends on User Story 2 (Embedding Generation) for embeddings to store
- User Story 4 (Configuration Management) is foundational and supports all other stories

## Parallel Execution Examples

- [P] Tasks within the same user story can be developed in parallel if they operate on different modules (e.g., crawler.py and cleaner.py)
- [P] Test development can run in parallel with implementation for each component
- [P] Documentation updates can be done in parallel with implementation tasks
